content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 2 for Project Technical Support III (Senior Technician) and 1 for Project Technical Support II (Technician).

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Technical Support III (Senior Technician): Three-year Graduate Degree in Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Histology / Medical Laboratory Technology / Allied Health Sciences + Three (3) years’ experience OR Postgraduate Degree in relevant subject. Project Technical Support II (Technician): 12th Pass in Science with Diploma (DMLT / MLT / Histotechnology / Allied Health) + 5 years’ experience OR Three-year Graduate Degree in relevant subject with 2 years’ experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Rishikesh Project Technical Support recruitment is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Technical Support positions at AIIMS Rishikesh. These include roles for Senior Technician and Technician.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support – III (Senior Technician)?
faq.answer: For the Senior Technician role, candidates need a Three-year Graduate Degree in Life Sciences or related fields with 3 years of experience, or a Postgraduate Degree in a relevant subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Project Technical Support posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided according to the Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support roles?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 28,000 per month, plus HRA, depending on the specific post (Technician or Senior Technician).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Rishikesh Project Technical Support recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed by a skill test and an in-person interview.

faq.question: Q8. How should I apply for the Project Technical Support positions?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, which will provide all detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support positions at AIIMS Rishikesh are contractual in nature.
